title: 第11章 黑化的沈秋第12章 双双打爆
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
平地起惊雷，众人如坠梦中，忍不住看了立柱好几次，然而现实并不会改变。
沈云从法阵中走出，这段时间他再次突破，如今已有炼气六层的境界。
‘拿出大半的修为就够了。
他没有扮猪吃老虎的想法，遮遮掩掩反而让一群小丑变本加厉，适当展露锋芒能少一堆麻烦事。
“我明明有更强的天赋，还夜以继日的修行，付出了无数汗水，为什么还是追不上他。”
沈秋面色铁青，感觉自己如同一个笑话，尤其在看到沈云漠视的目光后，嫉妒在不停啃食心脏。
沈狂涛立刻偃旗息鼓，整个人张大个嘴，像是上岸的鱼呼吸困难，躲在人群后生怕沈云注意到自己。
沈青书面色僵硬，很想去招揽沈云，然而刚放下了豪言壮语，真要行动无疑是自我打脸，他现在是骑虎难下。
至于其他人，过了很久才缓过了神，满脸敬畏之色，宛若看到了神话。
“一个月炼气三层，沈云究竟是如何做到的。”
“听说沈风首次测试也才炼气二层，莫非测灵阵坏掉了？”
“这世上总有超越想象的天才，沈云以前就异于常人，有这种表现也不算出乎意料。”
“…”
仿佛回到了过去，沈云再次奠定了威信，至于沈秋已经无人提及。
这就好比乡下的土财主，遇到了世袭罔替的王侯子弟，放到一起比只会贻笑大方。
沈飞燕已经做好空手而归的打算，没想到柳暗花明又一村，连忙上前邀请道：“你可愿加入风脉，我们会尽力满足你的要求。”
沈云看了她一眼，淡然道：“我没有什么条件，真要说的话，帮我照顾一下沈卿若。”
他对这些派系之争毫无兴趣，能有个保护伞就够用了。
拿人手短，吃人嘴软，以他的符道手艺何愁没有灵石，没必要欠下大因果。
沈飞燕愣了一下，没想到对方这么好说话，旋即承诺道：“卿若小姐是风脉重点培养之人，还请放心。”

这个条件出乎所有人的意料，等他们回过神来，沈云已经飘然离去。
“事了拂身去，真像沈云的风格，也许他才是天赋最强的那个。”
“换成是我，肯定要趁机提出要求，以他的表现得到的投资绝不会少。”
“我看人家根本没当回事，听说他和卿若小姐是青梅竹马，加入风脉恐怕只是这个原因罢了。”
“…”
沈秋死死地盯着他的背影，心中怒吼：‘我拼了命拿到的东西，你就如此不屑一顾吗？’
他还为了加入雷脉沾沾自喜，对方却根本没当一回事，嫉妒愈发的扭曲了他的心灵。
谁都没注意到，一缕黑色云烟悄无声息的飞入他体内。
“我们也回去吧。”
沈青书面沉如水，已经达成了招揽沈秋的目标，然而他却一点也高兴不起来。
回到家中，沈云立刻迎来了沈平生稀奇的目光。
“你这样看着我做什么？”
content_en:
There was thunder on the ground, and everyone seemed to be in a dream. They couldn't help but look at the pillar several times, but the reality would not change.
Chen Yun walked out of the magic circle. During this period, he broke through again and now reached the sixth level of Qi refining.
‘It’s enough to spend most of your cultivation.
He has no intention of pretending to be a pig and eating the tiger. Being secretive only makes a group of clowns worse. Showing off his talents appropriately can save him a lot of trouble.
"I obviously have a stronger talent, and I practice day and night and put in countless sweats. Why can't I catch up with him?"
Shen Qiu's face was livid, feeling like a joke, especially after seeing Shen Yun's indifferent gaze, jealousy kept gnawing at his heart.
Shen Kuangtao immediately stopped and opened his mouth wide, like a fish on the beach having difficulty breathing. He hid behind the crowd for fear that Shen Yun would notice him.
Shen Qingshu's face was stiff and he wanted to recruit Shen Yun. However, he had just put down his lofty words. If he really wanted to take action, it would undoubtedly be a slap in the face. He was now riding a tiger and was unable to get off.
As for the others, it took a long time to calm down, and their faces were full of awe, as if they had seen a myth.
"How did Shen Yun achieve three levels of Qi refining in one month?"
"I heard that Shen Feng's first test was at the second level of Qi Refining. Could it be that the spirit detection array is broken?"
"There are always talents beyond imagination in this world. Shen Yun has been different from ordinary people before, so it is not unexpected that he behaves like this."
“…”
As if he had returned to the past, Shen Yun once again established his prestige, and no one mentioned Shen Qiu.
This is like a rich man from the countryside meeting the hereditary and irreplaceable prince's children. Putting them together will only make people laugh.
Shen Feiyan had already prepared to leave empty-handed, but unexpectedly, another village came forward and invited her: "If you are willing to join Fengmai, we will try our best to meet your request."
Shen Yun glanced at her and said calmly: "I don't have any conditions. If you really want to say something, please help me take care of Shen Qingruo."
He has no interest in these factional disputes. It is enough to have a protective umbrella.
He has short hands and cannibalism, but with his skills in Talismans, there is no need to worry about not having spiritual stones, and there is no need to owe great karma.
Shen Feiyan was stunned for a moment, she didn't expect the other party to be so easy to talk to, and then promised: "Miss Qingruo is a person who is focused on cultivating Fengmai, so please don't worry."
This condition was beyond everyone's expectation. When they came to their senses, Shen Yun had already left.
"It's just like brushing it aside. It's like Shen Yun's style. Maybe he is the one with the most talent."
"If it were me, I would definitely take the opportunity to make a request. The investment he will receive based on his performance will never be less."
"I don't think he takes it seriously at all. I heard that he and Miss Qingruo are childhood sweethearts. I'm afraid that's the only reason why he joined Fengmai."
“…”
Shen Qiu stared at his back and roared in his heart: 'Are you so dismissive of what I worked so hard to get? ’
He was still complacent about joining the Thunder Vein, but the other party didn't take him seriously at all. Jealousy twisted his mind even more.
No one noticed that a wisp of black smoke flew into his body silently.
"Let's go back too."
Shen Qing's words were as heavy as water. He had achieved his goal of recruiting Shen Qiu, but he was not happy at all.
After returning home, Shen Yun immediately received Shen Pingsheng's strange gaze.
"Why are you looking at me like this?"
